notes: Hard bucket. The task chains five strict gates: (1) fix a C parsing bug in source so kvcat no longer short-circuits on the first malformed line; (2) the fix must free every allocation so valgrind reports zero definite leaks with no suppressions and no premature exit; (3) only /app/src/fixed.c may be touched while every other source/config file must stay byte-identical and no extra files may appear; (4) merge two divergent git branches resolving real config.toml and deps.txt conflicts under a documented dependency-merge rule; (5) leave reproducible /app/merged.diff and exact /app/deps.lock. Valgrind runs on the visible sample and four hidden token files (malformed lines interspersed, CRLF / missing trailing newline, leading-digit and malformed-value tokens, empty file, all-malformed) with exact byte-for-byte stdout comparison.
